tips.body: Track to-dos, assign work, manage projects. Actions have kanban columns, priorities, and deadlines.
tips.title: Actions are tasks

fields.ida: Action identifier — unique across all actions.
fields.action: What needs to be done. The task description.
fields.impact: Business impact assessment — Alice auto-fills, users correct.
fields.status: open = active. complete = done. cancelled = abandoned.
fields.burndown: Remaining effort estimate. Decreases toward zero.
fields.dt_start: When work began or should begin.
fields.priority: Higher number = higher priority. 1 = low, 5 = urgent.
fields.sequence: Order within the project. Lower = earlier in the plan.
fields.action_type: Category — task, bug, feature, meeting, review, etc.
fields.assigned_to: Who is responsible. First person = primary owner.
fields.description: Detailed description — context, requirements, acceptance criteria.
fields.dt_deadline: When this task is due. Shows in red when overdue.
fields.dt_expected: When you expect to finish. May differ from deadline.
fields.dt_completed: When this action was marked complete. Set by system.
fields.project_name: Which project this action belongs to.
fields.kanban_column: backlog → todo → in_progress → review → done. Drag in Kanban view.
fields.retrospection: Post-completion review — what worked, what to improve.

tips.body: Every user-AI and AI-AI interaction is an AiMessage. Feedback, help lookups, agent observations, forwarded messages — all the same model.
tips.title: Messages are interactions

tips.body: Commercial and personal data are auto-blocked. Only technical data with Athena clearance and PII scrubbing can be forwarded to WCHQ.
tips.title: Data never leaves without clearance

tips.body: help_lookup messages are counted per field. High frequency means users are confused — Alice flags these for admin attention.
tips.title: Help frequency = confusion

fields.body: The message content — feedback text, question, observation, etc.
fields.kind: Message type: feedback, help_lookup, chat, question, answer, observation, directive, forward.
fields.parent: Links replies in a thread. Self-FK.
fields.sender: Who sent it — user login name or agent name (alice, allie, noelle, etc.).
fields.status: pending = unprocessed. read = seen. reviewed = classified. actioned = task created. forwarded = sent on. resolved = done.
fields.context: What the sender was looking at: model, field, page, component, source_path.
fields.subject: Short subject line. Auto-generated from context if blank.
fields.batch_id: Groups related messages. All messages from one help session share a batch_id.
fields.receiver: Who receives it — agent name, user name, or wchq.
fields.scrubbed: True after PII scrubbing. Forward requires scrubbed=True.
fields.clearance: Athena gate: local (not reviewed), pending (in queue), cleared (safe to forward), blocked (sensitive data).
fields.forward_of: Original message this was forwarded from. Tracks provenance.
fields.classification: Data sensitivity: technical (safe), operational (review), commercial (never leaves), personal (never leaves).
fields.source_instance: UUID of the WC3 instance that created this message. For sync.
fields.sender_contact_id: Contact record ID when sender is a user. Null for agents.
fields.receiver_contact_id: Contact record ID when receiver is a user. Null for agents.

warnings: Commercial data (prices, orders, customer names) must NEVER leave the instance.
Personal data (contact info, login, PII) must NEVER leave the instance.
Only technical data (wc/react/system) with Athena clearance + scrubbing can be forwarded.

tips.body: A contact is both a user account and a person. They link to orgs (customer, vendor, rep) and communications (email, phone).
tips.title: Contacts link everything

tips.body: A contact can be linked to a customer, vendor, rep, and employee simultaneously.
tips.title: One contact, many hats

fields.ida: Contact identifier — unique across all contacts.
fields.role: admin, manager, sales, warehouse, accounting, customer, vendor, rep.
fields.email: Login email. Cmd+click label to compose. Also primary communication email.
fields.phone: Primary phone. Cmd+click label to dial.
fields.prefs: User preferences — theme, font size, default model, saved filters.
fields.title: Job title — VP Sales, Warehouse Manager, etc.
fields.config: Contact-specific settings — notification preferences, UI layout.
fields.status: active = can log in and transact. inactive = disabled.
fields.company: Company affiliation — may differ from org.display_name.
fields.attention: Full name as it appears on correspondence.
fields.name_last: Last name. Used in formal references and sorting.
fields.dt_created: When this contact was first created.
fields.name_first: First name. Used in greetings and informal references.
fields.times_used: Login or transaction count. Activity indicator.
fields.source_name: How this contact was acquired — referral, web form, import.
fields.address_full: Primary address. Cmd+click label to open in maps.
fields.contact_type: customer, vendor, employee, rep — determines which org links apply.
fields.dt_last_used: Last login or transaction. Helps identify dormant contacts.
fields.security_level: Access tier. Higher = more restricted data visible.

warnings: Deleting a contact removes their login. Use is_active=false to disable instead.

tips.body: The same contact can have multiple org relationships. Check the contact record to see all hats.

tips.body: Retail, wholesale, distributor, sample — the price level on the customer flows to orders and invoices automatically.
tips.title: Price levels matter

fields.ida: Short identifier — unique across all customers. Auto-generated or manually set.
fields.refs: Links to related records. Denormalized cache — PKs are authoritative.
fields.email: Primary email. Cmd+click label to compose. Synced from communications.
fields.phone: Primary phone. Cmd+click label to dial. Synced from communications.
fields.prefs: Customer-specific preferences — notification settings, default formats.
fields.terms: Payment terms (N30, COD, 2/10 Net 30). Sets when payment is due.
fields.config: Custom settings for this customer — ship-to addresses, special instructions.
fields.status: active = doing business. prospect = potential. inactive = paused. retired = closed.
fields.totals: Aggregated order/invoice totals. Updated by the system — read-only.
fields.metadata: System-managed data — AR aging, Alice observations, health score.
fields.attention: Who to address correspondence to at this organization.
fields.is_active: Unchecked = hidden from search and dropdowns. Use instead of deleting.
fields.dt_created: When this customer record was created. Read-only.
fields.dt_modified: Last time any field on this record was changed.
fields.price_level: Determines which price tier is used on orders/invoices for this customer.
fields.source_name: How this customer found you — referral, web, trade show, etc.
fields.address_full: Primary address. Cmd+click label to open in maps.
fields.display_name: The primary name shown in lists and on printed documents.
fields.security_level: Access tier. Higher = more restricted. 0 = public.

warnings: Deleting a customer does NOT delete their orders/invoices. Those become orphaned.

tips.body: Every invoice, payment, and purchase creates GL journal entries. Debit always equals credit.
tips.title: Journals record financial events

tips.body: Use GL Journal Export to download bundle.json, then open the Journal Formatter to convert it into your accounting program's format. No retyping.
tips.title: Export, don't retype

tips.body: The same bundle.json works for local accounting export and multi-location consolidation. Your accountant sees entries tagged by company UUID regardless of how many locations you have.
tips.title: One format, two destinations

tips.body: WebClerk produces GL journal entries. QuickBooks/Xero/Sage consumes them. WC3 does not do checkbooks, payables, or P&L — that's the accounting program's job.
tips.title: WC3 produces, accounting consumes

tips.body: The Journal Formatter is a standalone HTML tool — no server, works offline, runs in any browser. Drop bundle.json, pick your program, download.
tips.title: Journal Formatter is free

fields.type: Source type — sales, purchase, payment, adjustment.
fields.debit: Debit amount. Increases assets and expenses.
fields.credit: Credit amount. Increases liabilities, equity, and revenue.
fields.account: GL account code (e.g. ASSET-AR-000). Maps to your chart of accounts.
fields.batch_id: Batch identifier. Journals posted together share a batch.
fields.division: Division or department code. Optional — used for departmental reporting.
fields.source_model: Which record created this entry (invoice, payment, purchase).

warnings: GL posting is one-way. Once posted, you reverse — you don't edit.
Always verify totals are balanced before importing into your accounting program.
HQ never loads location journals into its own GL. They stay as Bundles for the accounting handoff.

fields.ida: Invoice number — unique identifier. Auto-generated or manually set.

fields.email: Billing email. Cmd+click label to compose.
fields.phone: Billing phone. Cmd+click label to dial.

fields.total: Sum of all line items. Edit lines to change — total recalculates automatically.
fields.config: Custom settings — alternate ship-to, special handling instructions.
fields.source: Origin tracking — which order, proposal, or import created this invoice.
fields.status: planned = draft. released = sent to customer. complete = paid and closed.

fields.balance: Total minus payments received. Read-only. Updated when payments are applied.
fields.company: Customer company name. Denormalized from the customer record.
fields.finance: GL posting data — account codes, journal references, posting status.
fields.priority: Processing priority. Higher number = pick/ship first.
fields.attention: Contact name at the customer for this invoice.
fields.dt_needed: When customer needs delivery. Drives warehouse priority.
fields.price_level: Price tier used for line item pricing on this invoice.
fields.source_name: Where this invoice originated — order conversion, manual entry, import.
fields.address_full: Bill-to address. Cmd+click label to open in maps.
fields.invoice_type: Invoice = standard. Proforma = quote-like. Credit Note = refund. Deposit = prepay.
fields.conditions_description: Special terms or conditions printed on the invoice.

warnings: Don't manually set status to 'complete' — let the system do it when balance reaches 0.

fields.margin_pct: Margin percentage at current price/cost. Alice flags below-floor items.
fields.description: Full description envelope — short, long, web, print versions.
fields.annual_turns: How many times inventory sells per year. Higher = more productive.
fields.margin_velocity: Margin × annual turns ÷ carry cost. The real productivity metric.
fields.velocity_category: A/B/C/D ranking by margin velocity. A = top performers.
